maintenance.description.defaultMessage: {server} est temporairement indisponible pour cause de maintenance. Veuillez réessayer plus tard.
maintenance.description.description: Explanation under the heading of the maintenance page. {server} is the server's name, or its host name.

maintenance.document_title.description: <title> of the maintenance page. {server} is the server's name, or its host name.

maintenance.notice.description: Heading over the administrators' notice (maintenance_message) on the maintenance page.

maintenance.status_page.description: Text of the link to the instance's status page (status_page_url) on the maintenance page.

maintenance.title.description: Heading of the maintenance page (ADR-0088) and the title of the maintenance problem of the client API.

maintenance.until.description: Label of the time the maintenance is expected to end, shown in UTC next to it on the maintenance page.
